subs: As you can see, C Fashion's retail data is all managed within Salesforce.
Now, let's see how this Salesforce data powers the customer experience through Agentforce.
The customer can directly log in to the C Fashion website and start a conversation with the Product Exchange Assistant.
The customer starts by asking, “Show my orders.”
Agentforce identifies the logged-in customer and retrieves their orders from Salesforce.
The customer can also see which items are eligible for exchange.
The customer selects the A-line dress and chooses to exchange it.
Agentforce asks for the desired size and color.
The customer requests L in yellow.
The agent checks the requested combination against the available inventory.
If that combination is unavailable, Agentforce automatically provides alternative options.
The customer selects XL in blue from the available options.
Agentforce then confirms the selected product and asks the customer to approve the exchange.
Once the customer confirms, the agent processes the exchange and creates the exchange record in Salesforce.
Since the replacement product is lower in price than the original item, the customer is informed that they will receive a $34 refund.
Finally, the exchange confirmation is displayed directly in the chat, along with the exchange number EX-0071.
